sampling.coordinateSystem: Y up, motion generally positive Z; source Left is positive X

clips.selectionEvidence: Successive LeftFoot forward-position maxima relative to Hips at source frames 56 and 187. Whole-foot relative-forward autocorrelation best period 129 frames; gait is not perfectly periodic.
Successive RightFoot forward-position maxima relative to Hips at source frames 140 and 314. Whole-foot relative-forward autocorrelation best period 174 frames.

retargetCautions: Motion is genuine recorded human skeleton data; derived role or age adjustments must be labeled authored adaptations, not captured elders or water carriers.
First BVH frame is a synthetic T-pose added by the converter; exclude it from animation.
Raw CMU source contains noise and foot/floor drift. Retargeting needs ground-contact correction and cycle-seam cleanup.
Preserve local contact phase while retiming by travelled distance; do not apply source root translation twice.
Source skeleton proportions and joint axes differ from target; use segment directions/rest-pose correction, not direct raw Euler assignment.
Source Left positive X differs from current target Left negative X; correct coordinate handedness without swapping actor identity.
